thread:
vendor-liaison: FYI vendor updated ETA for H100 tranche — bumped 2 weeks due to factory QA. partial shipments possible, asking if we want to split by region.
olivia: Ugh. Which regions are impacted? APAC or EU too?
daniel: APAC definitely — vendor called out a thermal batch they want to QA before shipping. EU/NA might get a small top-off earlier.
vendor-liaison: Correct. They can do a small air split (12 units) for NA by next week, remainder after QA (~+2w). APAC holds until QA complete.
sophie: Can we accept the 12 for NA and re-route some capacity from our dedicated reserved pool to APAC temporarily? Want to avoid starving onboarding jobs.
kevin: Depends on cost. Airsplit incurs ~$8k per AWB vs sea. Also vendor wants terminal insurance on that split.
olivia: What about RMA implications? If vendor does partial, any chance of mixed serials causing depot reconciliation pain?
vendor-liaison: They warned about mixed serials — will provide manifest but asked if Redwood can handle partial intake and temporary escrow for serials.
kevin: Escrow is fine, but ops needs clear AWB + manifest before we accept. Also we should request vendor to prepay return label for DOA units to reduce our RMA ops cost.
daniel: Agreed. Ask them to include prepaid RMA labels for first 30 days. We absorbed a lot of admin last wave.
vendor-liaison: Noted. I'm pushing for: (1) 12-unit NA airsplit with prepaid RMA labels; (2) manifest + per-serial photos; (3) vendor covers expedited brokerage for NA.
sophie: If they cover brokerage, we can accept the airsplit. For APAC, can we borrow 8 units from Dedicated pool for 3 weeks? ops team: @kevin, @daniel?
kevin: We can loan up to 6 units without breaking SLAs, but need finance signoff for cross-region billing adjustments. It'd be billed as a temporary transfer — ~0.6x discount rate.
daniel: I'll ping finance, but timeline is tight. Also we should set a canary: route non-production traffic to those borrowed units.
vendor-liaison: Vendor also flagged a customs hold risk in FRA — HS code question. Carrier-bot: AWB 123-45678901 status: held at FRA customs — awaiting HS confirmation.
kevin: Great, send them HS code 8542.31 and ask vendor to confirm invoice matches. If mismatch, customs will detain and broker fees spike.
olivia: Can you get ETA if customs clears today? We need to update customers.
vendor-liaison: Vendor said clearance could be same day if we provide invoice amendment now. They're prepping docs.
sophie: Operational asks: (a) Ops needs manifest + serial list 24h before arrival; (b) Depot wants photos for thermal batch flagged units; (c) Create a dedicated RMA tracking thread for these units.
vendor-liaison: Will request all three. Also negotiating partial replacement policy for any DOA found within 14 days — vendor leaning toward 60% credit + next-available replacement.
daniel: That's weak. We should push for full replacement or prepaid refurb credit. What leverage do we have?
vendor-liaison: We have a small leverage: we have an open reserved purchase order for Q2; we can link better DOA terms in that agreement if they expedite the NA split.
evey: (bot note) — finance approval required for cross-region loan; please fill the transfer form: /forms/transfer-request.
kevin: I'll start the transfer form now. Finance: ping @olivia for spending approval.
olivia: I'm ok with temporary transfer on the condition vendor covers brokerage + prepaid RMA labels. Approve.
vendor-liaison: Vendor confirmed brokerage cover for NA airsplit if we accept next 48h. They will also send manifest + photos within 12h.
sophie: Great — once we have manifest I'll create the RMA-tracking thread and tag depot ops. Also please route canary traffic to borrowed units only.
daniel: I'll schedule the canary and set autoscale rules to avoid production impact.
vendor-liaison: Final ask — vendor wants sign-off on acceptance terms (prepaid labels + invoice amendment) by EOD to push air. Can someone confirm?
kevin: Confirmed from ops side.
olivia: Confirmed. finance pending but likely ok — @kevin please attach estimated brokerage credit to transfer form.
vendor-liaison: Perfect. I'll send an SLA amendment and the AWB + manifest once ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
carrier-bot: AWB 123-45678901 — customs update: invoice amendment requested (action: vendor-liaison).
